maria: FYI ran a quick perf pass on qwen2.5 after the autoscheduler change — seeing ~18% p99 latency regression for some multi-ling requests (CJK + emoji). Looks like kernel selection is falling back to the slow matmul path for certain KV head alignments.

akshay: which change? commit hash? can you paste the repro command you used?

maria: checkout: `main@0f3a4b6` (autoscheduler tie-breaker tweak). repro: `./bench --model qwen2.5 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --samples samples/cjk_mixed.txt`

lee: I saw similar in CI but thought it was noisy. Here's the kernel selector log snippet when it regresses: 
```
selector: candidate_kernels=[fused_attn_fast, aten_matmul]
scoring: fused_attn_fast=0.67, aten_matmul=0.69  # tie-breaker favored aten
reason: kv_head_dim mismatch (expected 64, actual 80) -> fallback penalty applied
```

sasha: interesting — tokenizer splits for CJK+emoji cause extra tokens around emoji clusters, so effective seq length + kv head alignment changes. Batching heuristics assume average tokenization shape and miss the alignment case. quick numbers: normal english batch p99 84ms, cjk+emoji 102ms.

maria: yup. I traced it to two things: (1) autoscheduler weight changed so it prefers kernels with smaller theoretical FLOPs even if they force aten fallback when kv dims aren't aligned; (2) tokenizer stretches some sequences, hitting that aten path. Proposed short-term fix: adjust selector scoring to add a hard penalty for aten fallback when "kv_head_dim % 16 != 0" (keeps fused path if possible). Patch diff idea: 
```
{"selector": {"penalties": {"aten_fallback": 0.25, "kv_misaligned": 0.40}}}
```

akshay: can you run a micro-bench with the patched scoring so we know impact on avg throughput? I can run across our GPU types. Also please include docker tag.

maria: will run and push results to the perf board. Docker tag I used for the failing run: `redwood/runtime:canary-20260312-0f3a4b6`.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-20260312-0f3a4b6 -> eng-runtime-canary @ 2026-03-12T14:05:00Z :rocket:

akshay: giving it a go now on A100 and T4, will post numbers in ~20m.

maria: thanks. follow-up plan: (1) run micro-bench with penalty tweak, (2) if regressed case recovered, add unit test for CJK+emoji tokenization shape to guard selector, (3) small PR to revert autoscheduler tie-breaker until we can incorporate kv-head-awareness. filing an issue now.
thread_text_summary: Perf regression on qwen2.5 p99 for CJK+emoji due to kernel selector favoring aten fallback when KV head dims misalign; plan: tweak selector penalties, bench on GPU fleet, add tokenizer-shaped unit test, consider reverting autoscheduler tie-breaker.
